import pandas as pd

def main():
    # Source file path
    source_path_0 = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_67/test_0.csv"
    
    # Load source data
    df_source0 = pd.read_csv(source_path_0)
    
    # Inspect columns of source0:
    # ['user_id', 'time', 'sore.throat.cough', 'runnynose.congestion.sneezing', 'fever', 
    #  'nausea.vomiting.diarrhea', 'sad.depressed', 'open.stressed']
    #
    # Target schema: ['user_id': int, 'sad': float, 'stressed': float]
    #
    # Transformation plan:
    # - Group by user_id (since multiple rows per user)
    # - Aggregate sad.depressed and open.stressed by taking the mean per user_id
    # - Rename sad.depressed -> sad, open.stressed -> stressed
    #
    # This matches the target examples where sad and stressed are floats between 0 and 1.
    
    # Group by user_id and aggregate mean of sad.depressed and open.stressed
    df_agg = df_source0.groupby('user_id', as_index=False).agg({
        'sad.depressed': 'mean',
        'open.stressed': 'mean'
    })
    
    # Rename columns to target schema
    df_agg.rename(columns={
        'sad.depressed': 'sad',
        'open.stressed': 'stressed'
    }, inplace=True)
    
    # Ensure correct dtypes
    df_agg['user_id'] = df_agg['user_id'].astype(int)
    df_agg['sad'] = df_agg['sad'].astype(float)
    df_agg['stressed'] = df_agg['stressed'].astype(float)
    
    # Save to target path
    target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_67/target_multisource_cot.csv"
    df_agg.to_csv(target_path, index=False)
    
if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
